title: 72 #### 5.2 Juvenile Delinquency under Local & Special Laws A total of 61,774 offences were recorded in 1974 under the Local & Special Laws registering a decrease of 3·2 per cent over 1973. The offences under the Arms Act, the Opium Act, the Prohibition Act and Miscellaneous offences were responsible for this decline inspite of the fact that the offences under the Gambling Act, the Excise Act, the Explosive & the Explosive Substance Act, the Motor Vehicles Act, the Indian Railways Act and the Suppression of Immoral Traffic in Women & Girls Act registered increase during 1974 over 1973. The relevant statistics are presented in Table 32.
